description:
Living a life of conformity in a group while suppressing their own desires, third-year high school student Do-young Joo meets Ye-chan Seo, an arts and physical education student, and feels a strong curiosity and attraction toward him.

Feeling a sense of liberation watching Ye-chan, who seems extraordinary and free-spirited, Do-young finds that Ye-chan, despite being indifferent to others, finds Do-young’s interest in him endearing.

“But how did it come to this... standing naked in front of you?”
